parameters.jsCode:
const item = $json;
function q(value) { return String(value ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''"); }
function json(value) { return JSON.stringify(value ?? {}).replace(/'/g, "''"); }
const metadata = {
  source_channel: 'chatwoot_waba',
  profile_name: item.profile_name || null,
  chatwoot_account_id: item.chatwoot_account_id || null,
  chatwoot_inbox_id: item.chatwoot_inbox_id || null,
  chatwoot_inbox_name: item.chatwoot_inbox_name || null,
  chatwoot_conversation_id: item.chatwoot_conversation_id || null,
  chatwoot_message_id: item.chatwoot_message_id || null,
  normalized_route: item.normalized_route || null,
  button_payload: item.button_payload || null,
  button_text: item.button_text || null,
  routing_status: item.routing_status || null,
  salesforce_http_status: item.salesforce_http_status || null,
  sf_account_id: item.sf_account_id || null,
  sf_contract_id: item.sf_contract_id || null,
};

const sql = "SET search_path TO renovation_dev, public;\n" +
"WITH inbound AS (\n" +
"  SELECT '" + q(item.phone_e164) + "'::text AS phone,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_id) + "'::text AS wa_message_id,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_text) + "'::text AS content,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_type || 'text') + "'::text AS message_type,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_timestamp) + "'::timestamptz AS occurred_at,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.chatwoot_conversation_id || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_conversation_id,\n" +
"         '" + json(metadata) + "'::jsonb AS metadata\n" +
"), customer_match AS (\n" +
"  SELECT * FROM customers WHERE phone = (SELECT phone FROM inbound) LIMIT 1\n" +
"), existing_by_chatwoot AS (\n" +
"  SELECT c.* FROM conversations c WHERE c.chatwoot_conversation_id = NULLIF((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound), '') LIMIT 1\n" +
"), existing_by_customer AS (\n" +
"  SELECT c.* FROM conversations c JOIN customer_match cm ON cm.id = c.customer_id\n" +
"  WHERE c.status IN ('bot_active','handed_off') ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1\n" +
"), existing_conv AS (\n" +
"  SELECT * FROM existing_by_chatwoot UNION ALL SELECT * FROM existing_by_customer LIMIT 1\n" +
"), created_conv AS (\n" +
"  INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, status, summary, chatwoot_conversation_id)\n" +
"  SELECT cm.id, 'bot_active'::conversation_status, 'Inbound Chatwoot WABA iniciado por WF-03B DEV', NULLIF((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound), '')\n" +
"  FROM customer_match cm WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_conv)\n" +
"  RETURNING *\n" +
"), conv AS (\n" +
"  SELECT * FROM existing_conv UNION ALL SELECT * FROM created_conv LIMIT 1\n" +
"), linked_conv AS (\n" +
"  UPDATE conversations c SET chatwoot_conversation_id = NULLIF((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound), ''), updated_at = now()\n" +
"  FROM conv\n" +
"  WHERE c.id = conv.id\n" +
"    AND NULLIF((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound), '') IS NOT NULL\n" +
"    AND (c.chatwoot_conversation_id IS NULL OR c.chatwoot_conversation_id = (SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound))\n" +
"  RETURNING c.*\n" +
"), inserted_message AS (\n" +
"  INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender, message_type, content, wa_message_id, metadata, occurred_at)\n" +
"  SELECT conv.id, 'inbound'::message_direction, 'customer'::message_sender, inbound.message_type, inbound.content, NULLIF(inbound.wa_message_id, ''), inbound.metadata, inbound.occurred_at\n" +
"  FROM conv CROSS JOIN inbound\n" +
"  WHERE conv.id IS NOT NULL\n" +
"  ON CONFLICT (wa_message_id) DO NOTHING\n" +
"  RETURNING id\n" +
"), pause AS (\n" +
"  SELECT pause_customer_campaigns(cm.id, 'customer_inbound_chatwoot') AS paused FROM customer_match cm\n" +
"), history_rows AS (\n" +
"  SELECT m.direction, m.sender, m.content, m.occurred_at\n" +
"  FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = (SELECT id FROM conv)\n" +
"  ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 12\n" +
"), history AS (\n" +
"  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction', direction, 'sender', sender, 'content', content, 'occurred_at', occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent_messages\n" +
"  FROM history_rows\n" +
")\n" +
"SELECT\n" +
"  (SELECT phone FROM inbound) AS phone_e164,\n" +
"  (SELECT wa_message_id FROM inbound) AS wa_message_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT content FROM inbound) AS inbound_text,\n" +
"  (SELECT id FROM customer_match) AS customer_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT full_name FROM customer_match) AS full_name,\n" +
"  (SELECT vehicle_brand FROM customer_match) AS vehicle_brand,\n" +
"  (SELECT vehicle_model FROM customer_match) AS vehicle_model,\n" +
"  (SELECT vehicle_type FROM customer_match) AS vehicle_type,\n" +
"  (SELECT service_name FROM customer_match) AS service_name,\n" +
"  (SELECT expiration_date FROM customer_match) AS expiration_date,\n" +
"  (SELECT gps_status FROM customer_match) AS gps_status,\n" +
"  (SELECT opportunity_stage FROM customer_match) AS opportunity_stage,\n" +
"  (SELECT opportunity_closed FROM customer_match) AS opportunity_closed,\n" +
"  (SELECT campaign_paused FROM customer_match) AS campaign_paused,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_contact_id FROM customer_match) AS salesforce_contact_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_opportunity_id FROM customer_match) AS salesforce_opportunity_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_contract_id FROM customer_match) AS salesforce_contract_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_vehicle_id FROM customer_match) AS salesforce_vehicle_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT id FROM conv) AS conversation_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT status FROM conv) AS conversation_status,\n" +
"  (SELECT identity_verified FROM conv) AS identity_verified,\n" +
"  (SELECT persuasion_attempts FROM conv) AS persuasion_attempts,\n" +
"  (SELECT handoff_reason FROM conv) AS handoff_reason,\n" +
"  (SELECT promotion_communicated FROM conv) AS promotion_communicated,\n" +
"  (SELECT contact_preference FROM conv) AS contact_preference,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM linked_conv), (SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM conv), (SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound)) AS chatwoot_conversation_id,\n" +
"  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_message) AS message_inserted,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT paused FROM pause), false) AS campaign_paused_now,\n" +
"  is_automatic_send_allowed(now()) AS automatic_send_allowed,\n" +
"  (SELECT recent_messages FROM history) AS recent_messages,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.routing_status || '') + "'::text AS routing_status,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_account_id || '') + "'::text AS sf_account_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_contract_id || '') + "'::text AS sf_contract_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_contract_status || '') + "'::text AS sf_contract_status,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_contract_end_date || '') + "'::text AS sf_contract_end_date,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.chatwoot_account_id || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_account_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.chatwoot_inbox_id || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_inbox_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.chatwoot_inbox_name || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_inbox_name;";

return [{ json: { ...item, persist_sql: sql } }];

## REN - DEV - WF-03C - Inbound Master (CRIS Port)

Port seguro del flujo de ventas `3eNH717Puuma0ec8` / `CRIS-01 - Inbound Master`.

No es copia directa: el flujo fuente tiene secretos hardcodeados y reglas comerciales de ventas. Esta variante conserva solo patrones tecnicos utiles y los adapta a Renovaciones.

Canal objetivo: inbox WABA `Agente AIGENTS RENOVACIONES 9663`.

Reglas Renovaciones:
- filtra solo `message_created` incoming de contacto
- ignora otros inboxes, salientes y notas privadas
- schema `renovation_dev`
- pausa campanas por inbound
- ruteo Salesforce DEV o modo local DEV con `RENOV_DEV_USE_LOCAL_LEADS=true`
- off-hours Ecuador
- Camila con guardrails y handoff WF-04
- dry-run de envios con `RENOV_DEV_DRY_RUN_SENDS=true`
- responde por Chatwoot cuando dry-run esta apagado

Mantener inactivo hasta pruebas controladas. No introducir precios/promociones fuera de Salesforce.
